LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionRecruit.label: The Endless Traveler
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionRecruit.letterText: A Milira traveler has appeared near the colony. She has blue hair streaked with pink and a halo that seems to have been dressed like a wreath by her own hand. Her clothes look quite unlike those of the skyfolk you're used to seeing. She introduces herself as Neiyu. She says she wanders from place to place and would like to stay in your colony for a good while. If you welcome her, she promises to keep lending you her remarkable strength. If you turn her away, she'll look for another settlement and continue her journey without a destination.
